title: BodyParts3D 4.3: complete verified mesh set, downloader and subset selector
description:
Tools for obtaining the full-resolution BodyParts3D / Anatomography version 4.3 anatomical mesh set, which no published archive or documented Web API distributes: the bulk archive ships only the 99%-polygon-reduced version 4.0, and the documented Web API returns rendered images rather than geometry.

A downloader drives the Anatomography viewer's own endpoints and pins the result to version 4.3 by seeding it from the version-stamped 4.3 manifest, then verifies that every declared element is present and loadable. A subset selector takes named groups of elements by regular expression over their Foundational Model of Anatomy names, so a whole organ can be requested even where version 4.3 supplies it only in parts — the cerebrum as gyri, the lung as bronchopulmonary segments, the heart as chamber walls. The verified 3,210-mesh set is included.
